privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Brick Finder is a personal project. Here's the short version of how data flows.
privacy.storageDetail: When you use photo search, your image is sent to our recognition partner (Brickognize) for matching, then discarded. We don't keep a copy on our servers.
privacy.saved: Saved sets stay in your browser.
privacy.savedDetail: Your collection lives in your browser's localStorage under the key brickfinder:saved. Clear your browser data and it's gone.
privacy.credits: Set data is provided by Rebrickable. Image recognition by Brickognize.
